book.title: 1934: Caught in the Crossroads
book.tagline: A relic from the Crusades resurfaces, threatening a world already on the brink.
description: Europe, 1934. The scars of the Great War have not healed, and something buried for centuries has begun to surface.

An archaeological discovery in Yugoslavia uncovers records pointing toward the True Cross — lost after Saladin's victory at Hattin, and carried by the Ottomans to the walls of Vienna. It never arrived, and now it becomes a hunt through Eastern Europe for its two hundred-and-fifty-year hiding place. When Nazi operatives move to seize the findings, four unlikely allies are pulled into a race they had no idea was on. But one they cannot afford to lose.

A war veteran turned security director. His actress sister, who insisted on coming. A Yugoslav archaeologist who found what he shouldn't have. A German academic who was expelled by the new regime for standing for her opinions.
But a German officer is already ahead of them — one who has been moving pieces on this board since before they knew the game existed.

1934: Caught in the Crossroads is a historical adventure about ideology, memory,  and the people caught between the collapsing world in front of them and the people rushing forward to replace it with their own image.
